article.headline: Rollins' 26 help Denver defeat St. Thomas 82-80
article.description: — Julius Rollins scored 26 points as Denver beat St. Thomas 82-80 on Saturday.
article.linkText: Rollins' 26 help Denver defeat St. Thomas 82-80
article.story: DENVER -- — Julius Rollins scored 26 points as Denver beat St. Thomas 82-80 on Saturday. Rollins added six rebounds for the Pioneers (15-15, 8-7 Summit League). Carson Johnson scored 25 points, going 8 of 13 from the floor, including 3 for 7 from 3-point range, and 6 for 7 from the line. Logan Kinsey shot 2 of 5 from the field and 3 for 4 from the line to finish with seven points. Nick Janowski led the way for the Tommies (21-8, 10-4) with 19 points and six rebounds. Ryan Dufault added 13 points for St. Thomas. Carter Bjerke also had 10 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
